examples: can you give me the attendances of [first_name] [last_name]
Show me the last attendance record of [first_name] [last_name]
common_patterns.sql_template: SELECT a.*, e.first_name, e.last_name, e.staff_id FROM attendances a JOIN employees e ON a.employee_id = e.id WHERE e.first_name = '{first_name}' AND e.last_name = '{last_name}' ORDER BY a.attendance_date DESC, a.clock_in DESC
common_patterns.note: For queries like 'can you give me the attendances of Alveena Rehmatullah', extract first_name='Alveena' and last_name='Rehmatullah' from the full name

examples: Show me employees who were late yesterday
common_patterns.sql_template: SELECT e.first_name, e.last_name, e.staff_id, a.attendance_date, a.clock_in, a.time_late FROM attendances a JOIN employees e ON a.employee_id = e.id WHERE a.attendance_status = 'late'
SELECT e.first_name, e.last_name, e.staff_id, a.attendance_date, a.overtime, a.total_work FROM attendances a JOIN employees e ON a.employee_id = e.id WHERE a.overtime != '00:00:00'

examples: Show attendance summary for this month
common_patterns.sql_template: SELECT DATE(a.attendance_date) as date, COUNT(*) as total_attendance, SUM(CASE WHEN a.attendance_status = 'present' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as present_count, SUM(CASE WHEN a.attendance_status = 'late' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as late_count FROM attendances a

time_modifiers.this_month: WHERE MONTH(a.attendance_date) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND YEAR(a.attendance_date) = YEAR(CURDATE())
time_modifiers.last_month: WHERE MONTH(a.attendance_date) = MONTH(CURDATE()) - 1 AND YEAR(a.attendance_date) = YEAR(CURDATE())

common_patterns.group_by: GROUP BY DATE(a.attendance_date) ORDER BY date

common_patterns.sql_template: SELECT e.first_name, e.last_name, e.staff_id, e.email, e.contact_no, e.department_id, e.designation_id, e.company_id FROM employees e WHERE e.first_name = '{first_name}' AND e.last_name = '{last_name}'

examples: what is the employee name whose staff id is [staff_id]
Get employee details for staff ID [staff_id]
common_patterns.sql_template: SELECT first_name, last_name, staff_id, email, contact_no, department_id, designation_id FROM employees WHERE staff_id = '{staff_id}'
SELECT e.first_name, e.last_name, e.staff_id, e.email, e.contact_no, d.department_name FROM employees e JOIN departments d ON e.department_id = d.id WHERE d.department_name = '{department}'

examples: Find employees who didn't come to work
common_patterns.sql_template: SELECT e.first_name, e.last_name, e.staff_id FROM employees e WHERE e.id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT employee_id FROM attendances WHERE DATE(attendance_date) = '{date}')
